post.title: Stop Talking About the Weather (Strangers Want the Deep Stuff) #shorts
post.description: Weather talk or deep talk: which are you? Send this to the friend who only talks about the weather. Milo is at a party, on his third chat about rain. Deep questions feel like too much. But in 'Overly Shallow? Miscalibrated Expectations Create a Barrier to Deeper Conversation' (Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, published 2021), Michael Kardas, Amit Kumar and Nicholas Epley ran 12 experiments with more than 1,800 people, mostly strangers, talking about deep questions ('Can you describe a time you cried in front of another person?') or shallow ones ('What do you think about the weather today?'). Conversations felt less awkward and more connecting than people expected, especially the deep ones: we underestimate how interested others are in getting to know us. Ask one real question. #psychology #shorts #smalltalk #conversation #overthinking
